free_text: The patient is a 61-year-old male with an elevated PSA of 11.0 ng/mL and moderate LUTS. MRI showed a focal area of restricted diffusion in the right peripheral zone, but no extracapsular extension or seminal vesicle invasion was identified. The prior biopsy showed a benign Gleason score of 0+0 (ISUP grade group 0), though AI predicted grade group 2. Management assessment is continued surveillance, balancing the potential benefit of intervention against the risk of over-treatment given the equivocal imaging findings.
